fixture.hostile_destination_setup: destination/link is a pre-existing directory symlink to a sibling outside directory

source_mechanism_match.observed_source_sequence: lexical member normalization -> join/normpath -> os.path.exists/os.makedirs for upperdirs -> open(targetpath, 'wb')
source_mechanism_match.interpretation: The experiment reproduces the source-level consequence that lexical member sanitization does not by itself prevent traversal through a pre-existing destination symlink component.

f2_boundary.finding: This does not show a current F2 exploit. F2 release_integrity verifies an already-materialized tree and rejects symlink entries. The result only validates why the one-handoff ZIP should be materialized into a fresh/private staging directory and verified before installer use.

counterfactual: The clean empty-destination control stayed inside the staging root. Therefore the reproduced failure requires a hostile/pre-existing destination path component in this experiment; it is not evidence that CPython extractall escapes an empty private staging root for this member name.
next_exact_action: If no overlapping claim exists, run one E4 F2 component ablation using the exact release_integrity module: compare direct/pre-existing extraction versus fresh private staging plus post-extraction manifest verification and establish which adversarial cases are already rejected by existing F2 gates versus which require archive preflight/contract wiring.
